purpose: Executable ORCA three-class mask contract with strict fragmented non-tissue protection.

constraints.mask_statement: Require preprocessing revision and original-label-map digest and accept only the declared non-tissue/non-carcinoma/carcinoma signature.
known_limitations: Current signature checking is not a substitute for certified full-dataset profile statistics.

constraints.mask_statement: Preserve every non-tissue pixel exactly, including one-pixel and internal fragments; non-tissue cannot seed Tumor or Other tissue, cannot be relabeled first, and cannot be crossed, filled, eroded, dilated, or bridged over.
generation_handoff: Exclude protected non-tissue fragments from the inpaint region.
known_limitations: The reason for each fragmented zero region is not encoded and is irrelevant to the pixel-exact invariant.

constraints.mask_statement: Allow only Other tissue to Tumor or Tumor to Other tissue at an existing directed interface; never claim or emit Stroma, Immune, Normal epithelium, Vessel, Necrosis, or another unavailable class.
generation_handoff: Use H&E to render the actual non-carcinoma substrate; the mask must retain the coarse Other tissue statement.
known_limitations: Other tissue is irreducibly heterogeneous in this profile.

constraints.mask_statement: Reject islands, bridges, source splits, target merges, new/filled holes, detached edits, and short/deep or rectangle-like changed regions.
generation_handoff: Nest/cord/keratin morphology remains a downstream oral-SCC rendering and audit requirement.
known_limitations: Coarse mask topology cannot verify oral-SCC microscopic architecture.
